_note: Initial baseline placeholder. mutmut cannot run natively on Windows (see WINDOWS_LIMITATION.md; upstream issue boxed/mutmut#397), so this file was generated from structural analysis on a Windows checkout. The 'mutants_total' field per module is the AST-derived count of mutmut-style mutation operators (arithmetic, comparison, boolean, unary, constant, return) and is included so the mutation-nightly workflow can compute per-module ratios even before the first Linux CI run. The 'killed' / 'survived' / 'score' fields per module are populated by the next successful run of .github/workflows/mutation-nightly.yml; treat null as 'unmeasured' rather than 'zero'. When the Linux workflow overwrites this file on its first run, the overall_score and module scores will be the authoritative S-tier gate measurement.
